subject.title: refactor(memory-wiki): move compiled cache to plugin state

question: Should `registerMemoryPromptPreparation` be accepted as a permanent public Plugin SDK contract, including its prepared-state and failure behavior across legacy and custom context engines?
rationale: This is a new cross-plugin lifecycle API rather than a Memory Wiki-only implementation detail; the protected maintainer signal and stated architecture request indicate that its long-term contract needs a human confirmation.

options.title: Confirm and land the lifecycle contract
options.body: Confirm the async preparation hook as the supported Plugin SDK seam, then require runtime proof for the Memory Wiki migration before merge.

options.title: Keep preparation plugin-local
options.body: Avoid the new public hook and redesign Memory Wiki around existing synchronous and runtime seams if the cross-plugin contract is not intended.

recommendation.title: Confirm and land the lifecycle contract
recommendation.body: Confirm the async preparation hook as the supported Plugin SDK seam, then require runtime proof for the Memory Wiki migration before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed implementation and stated requested architecture span both the Plugin SDK and Memory Wiki owner boundary.
